idea-plugin.name: IDE Pilot
idea-plugin.description:
Lets AI agents see and drive the IDE over MCP, the way the Playwright MCP drives a browser. For plugin development and UI testing in the runIde sandbox.

Tools

  • pilot_action – runs an IDE action by ID and returns what it showed (hints, popups, dialogs, notifications), or finds actions by ID or menu text.
  • pilot_click – clicks the component or row with a ref: left, middle or right button, double-click, with modifier keys; or hovers over it to show tooltips, or drags it onto another ref.
  • pilot_editor – reads an editor's text, caret and problems, and lists or applies its Alt+Enter actions.
  • pilot_evaluate – runs a Groovy script inside the IDE.
  • pilot_log – the idea.log tail, the IDE's caught exceptions, recent UI freezes, notifications, stdout/stderr, or Run/Debug sessions (mode, state, process ID) and their console text, and Terminal tabs, or test run results (counts, failed tests with message and stack), by tab name or running only.
  • pilot_open – opens a project, or a file at a line.
  • pilot_screenshot – PNG of a component, or of the active window with its popups.
  • pilot_scroll – scrolls a scroll pane by pages or to its top or bottom, or a list, tree or table to the row with some text.
  • pilot_settings – effective values of registry keys, Advanced Settings and IDE and project settings, defaults included.
  • pilot_snapshot – the visible UI as a text tree of windows, components, list and tree rows, and Compose (Jewel) UI, with role, name, state and a ref to act on; paged, optionally with screen positions, and optionally with every row of lists and trees, not only those that show.
  • pilot_type – types text and presses keys, optionally replacing the content; shortcuts run their actions; selects combo box items by text; holds modifier keys down across calls until released.
  • pilot_window – brings a window to the front, resizes it, or closes it.
  • pilot_wait_for – waits for text to show or go, for indexing or background tasks to finish, for new Run console or Terminal output, or for a time.

The server listens on localhost and needs a token: generate it in Settings | Tools | IDE Pilot and paste it into the agent's MCP settings.
